instructions:
1. Stand with your feet together and knees slightly bent.
2. Place your hands on your knees for support.
3. Keep your knees together and circle them slowly to one side.
4. Make small controlled circles in one direction.
5. Switch and circle in the other direction.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and stay in control.
2. Keep your knees close together.
3. Stop if you feel any knee pain.
4. Breathe steadily throughout.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended overhead.
2. Step your right foot behind and across your left leg.
3. Bend both knees to lower into a curtsy and bring your hands down to your sides.
4. Push through your left heel to stand back up and clap your hands overhead.
5. Repeat on the other side, alternating each rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight.
2. Lower under control to protect your knees.
3. Keep your front knee tracking over your foot.
4. Push through the heel of the front foot.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet together and arms out to your sides.
2. Jump your feet out to a wide stance.
3. At the same time bring your arms in front and clap your hands at chest level.
4. Jump your feet back together and open your arms back out.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your knees slightly bent to absorb impact.
2. Exhale as you jump out and clap.
3. Hold a steady rhythm.
4. Land softly through the balls of your feet.

instructions:
1. Start in a plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Bend your elbows and lower until your chest is just above the floor.
4. Push explosively so your hands leave the floor.
5. Clap your hands in front of your chest, then land with hands back down.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive hard through your chest, shoulders, and triceps.
2. Land softly to protect your wrists.
3. Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.
4. Exhale as you push and clap.

instructions:
1. Start in a plank on the floor with your hands under your shoulders.
2. Place a padded stool just in front of you.
3. Brace your core and place your right hand, then left hand, onto the stool.
4. Step your hands back down to the floor one at a time.
5. Keep alternating which hand leads.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
2. Move under control and grip the stool firmly.
3. Set the stool on a non-slip surface.
4. Keep your hips level and core braced.
